entities.name: Eric of Brunswick-Grubenhagen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eric of Brunswick-Grubenhagen was from 1508 to 1532 prince-bishop of Paderborn and Osnabrück. In 1532, he was elected bishop of Münster, however, he died before he could be consecrated.
